observations.text: Diagonal washes loosened the pale grid left by horizontal and vertical passes.
Overlapping broad round oil faces filled the body, but starts made scalloped shoulders.
Sampled shoulder ellipse and base connected starts into a continuous vessel.
Densely sampled handle curve stayed smoothly open; upper end initially floated.
Connector joined upper handle; dark oval opening established depth.
Broad warm left and cool right neighbors joined the pale middle patch.
Single compact loaded rim reflection survived whole view.
Broad overlaps filled pale holes left by circular leaf sweeps.
Compact flower throat separated petals, though overall flower stayed round.
Broad watercolor quieted lower gaps without new oil relief.
Thin stamped seam became a strong continuous rail.
Broad warm neighbors interrupted seam color while retaining raised joins.
Sparse leaf veins stayed subordinate; right pan showed sharp stem elbows.
Sampled stem neighbor softened color slightly but retained original angular relief; petal extensions broke symmetry.
Broad upper washes reduced pale peripheral gaps.
Shoulder light clarified warm face, but attachment shadow became an isolated dark slash.
Broader loaded warm neighbors removed isolated slash at whole view and joined spout root.
Final leaf edges and ground wash settled plant; filled metal planes and compact rim glint hold. Regular bristles, raised joins, blunt flower and mottled ground remain.
